name: valid template with outputs and checks
valid bound parameters
sql:
-- @input source
-- @param connection: connection = ""
-- @param path: file(connection)
-- @param secret: secret(connection)
-- @param schema: schema_name(connection) = "public"
-- @param table: table_name(schema)
-- @param columns: column_selection(source)
-- @param amount: column(source)
-- @param items: list<text>
-- @param mode: choice(a|b) = "a"
-- @output result
SELECT * FROM {{ connection }}.{{ schema }}.{{ table }};

name: valid export without outputs
icon and color among the descriptive directives
sql:
-- @label Paid orders
-- @description Keep paid orders.
-- @icon filter
-- @color green
-- @input source
-- @output result
SELECT * FROM {{ source }};

name: unknown icon and color only warn
quoted reference only warns
sql:
-- @input source
-- @param status: text
-- @output result
SELECT * FROM {{ source }} WHERE status = '{{ status }}';
